one_liner_zh: Datadog 營收年增逾32%、EPS 大超18%，雲端可觀測性需求強勁，惟本益比逾600倍估值偏高。
one_liner_en: Datadog beat EPS by over 18% with 32% revenue growth on strong cloud observability demand, though its 600x P/E remains extreme.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 18.25%、營收年增 32.15%，雙雙強勁。
ai_view_zh: 訊號偏正向：營收與獲利雙超預期，反映可觀測性需求受 AI 與雲端遷移結構性支撐。短期股價對財報應有正面反應，但 609 倍本益比意味市場已高度定價成長，任何成長減速或客戶留存惡化都可能引發劇烈回檔。中期應追蹤淨收入留存率（NRR）、大型客戶數成長、用量計費的環比動能，以及自由現金流率能否持續擴張以支撐估值。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: both revenue and earnings beat, reflecting structural observability demand from AI and cloud migration. Near term, the stock should react favorably, but a 609x P/E prices in heavy growth, so any deceleration or weaker retention could trigger sharp drawdowns. Mid term, track net revenue retention, large-customer growth, sequential usage momentum, and whether free cash flow margin keeps expanding to justify the multiple.
highlights_zh: EPS 0.60 美元，超預期 18.25%，獲利能力優於市場估計
營收約 10.1 億美元，年增 32.15%，維持高速成長
可觀測性與雲端監控需求受 AI 工作負載帶動
產品多元化（日誌、APM、安全）推升客戶單戶貢獻
highlights_en: EPS of $0.60 beat estimates by 18.25%, signaling strong profitability
Observability and cloud monitoring demand boosted by AI workloads
Product breadth (logs, APM, security) lifts per-customer spend
risks_zh: 本益比高達 609 倍，估值極度依賴成長持續兌現
雲端支出若放緩將直接衝擊用量計費營收
競爭者眾（New Relic、Grafana、雲端原生工具）
risks_en: P/E of 609x leaves valuation highly dependent on sustained growth
Any slowdown in cloud spending directly hits usage-based revenue
Intense competition from New Relic, Grafana and cloud-native tools
